collectible.title: Apple of Enlightenment
collectible.subtitle: Eat well and exorcise
collectible.text:
After you called out to the multiverse by praying and exorcised the Universal Cosmic Destroyer, he left behind this clairvoyant fruit— it’s apparently what drove him to the madness you saw after he transformed. It’s supposed to show you the future, but it won’t tell you the important stuff, like if Mother 3 will ever get an international release…

By the way, there are several characters you can each read a unique scene for when you pray against Giygas if they’re at your table! If you pick Giygas as your first opponent, click the green button to select your next opponent, and choose “Talked To By Selected” from the little drop-down menu next to the red “Back” button, every character who appears above the thin gray line is one who has their own different prayer scene!
collectible.unlock: Defeat Giygas using a strategy other than swapping your cards.
